profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer that enjoys designing and coding solutions to problems that ultimately help make people’s lives easier and more efficient, so that they then get to do more impactful things for others. 

I wrote my first line of code in GWBasic in 3rd grade, and have loved it ever since, and I knew it was what I wanted for a career since high school.

In school, college and in the course of my career, I have always been a go-to person for help. From letting my classmates in school copy my homework (I did tutor them later), and helping fellow schoolmates and college mates on their class projects, to places I have worked where I have helped in onboarding and mentoring new developers, performing code reviews, setting coding standards, and maintaining good clean code practices, as well as being a point of contact for answering questions about how things work or when things go wrong and need fixing, I am always ready to help move things forward.

My love of coding and helping others has been a great combination in making an impact on the customers of the solutions I work on as well as the people I work with.

My career has been a whirlwind of different systems and technologies ranging from installed Windows Forms desktop clients, to server-side web applications in ASP .NET WebForms and MVC, to single page applications with jQuery and then Angular and now in the cloud with Azure using Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes and Serverless, with heavy doses of DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Automated Testing, Design patterns, SOLID principles, Object Oriented Design and Clean Code.

So much more to learn, so many possibilities!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack developer involved in migration of the product from our own datacenter to Azure.
Implemented modernization of the UI with a new web application in Angular.
Built new APIs for the new UI as microservices deployed as Docker containers in Azure Kubernetes Service.
Built APIs around the existing system to leverage existing capabilities in the new UI to enable making more microservices in future.
Implemented continuous integration and delivery pipelines in Azure DevOps.
Collaborated with our Cloud Ops team to create Terraform to provision Azure resources, PowerShell scripts to deploy the monolith application and Helm to deploy services in Kubernetes in the Azure DevOps pipelines.
Currently working on a serverless solution with Azure functions and Azure Service Bus to query for different sources of data from the US Government and sync them into our system.
Team lead role in localization project to add support for display of the application in multiple languages that enabled expansion of product sales to Asia, Australia and Europe.
Team lead role in migration from Subversion to Git for source control, and in setup of continuous integration and automated deployment infrastructure using TeamCity with PowerShell that enabled us to move from 6-month release cycles to 1-month release cycles.
Participated in setting coding standards for all teams, conducted code reviews across teams, mentored developers in onboarding them to the product, assisted in design of solutions and code reviews across different teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Core developer on iCare and iWeb, web applications used for processing claims for mobile devices insured by Asurion. Currently working on the design and development of a new configurable feature-based ASP .NET MVC 5 application instead of a custom application per client to reduce duplication and maintenance of multiple code bases. Also playing a lead role in setting up a continuous deployment of the application to testing environments using Jenkins for Continuous Integration and Subversion for source control. Worked on another internal application called iCare, an ASP .NET WebForms application that transitioned into a single page application with jQuery and KnockoutJS that dynamically loads different KnockoutJS templates based on the client to allow for custom code for clients to be within one code base.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core developer on ImageRight, a document management and workflow software product specialized for the insurance industry.
Key role in design and development of a new web application to replace an installed product build with Windows Forms.
Single page application with jQuery, jQuery UI and ASP .NET MVC 4 communicating to WCF web services.
Implemented claims-based security model for authentication using Windows Identity Foundation and Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS 2.0).
Assisted in fixing defects and stabilization of integrations with other products and quickly became an expert in the area within and outside the department.
Stabilized and increased code coverage on the complex authorization security model of the system. 
Worked within a Scrum process, involved in grooming, estimation, design and implementation of enhancements and defects.
Assisted Technical Support and Professional Services in resolving issues in production using tools like WinDbg and custom logging with log4net.
Introduced concept of unit testing vs. integration testing in the department
Mentor for junior developers and new hires
Organized brown-bag sessions on a variety of technology topics to increase learning and knowledge sharing within the team

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the design and development of a new management information system utilizing C#, VB.NET & SQL Server to provide a centralized database and a user-friendly system to execute administrative processes (such as employment, budgeting, course scheduling, etc.) and reduce paperwork for the College of Arts & Sciences. Lead developer involved in all phases of the software development life cycle and worked with minimal supervision. Conducted interviews with end-users during requirements gathering phase. Designed and developed 3-tier Windows Forms Application in VB.NET with MMC Console interface for taking care of the employment process. Developed a wizard using VB.NET and XML to guide users through the different types of employment and enter required information to produce forms in printed and electronic format. Developed web application in ASP.NET with C# and MS SQL Server 2000 to maintain an inventory of buildings and rooms with data filtering, searching and report building features.

Developed new website for the College of Arts and Sciences in ASP.NET with MS Access as back-end database. Made use of data binding and web server controls to keep pages dynamic and easy to maintain. Created forms to send emails through the website to staff within the college and to me. Used JavaScript for client-side processing and CSS styles to design the pages. Key participant in the website development team in making decisions about design and content of the website.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Intern on a software development team that worked on an image analysis software in Java called Skipper used for research in marine bacteria. Responsible for developing a feature to filter bacterial cells on an image of a water sample based on size and shape. Made use of decision trees to detect different shapes of cells.
